name_research_decision.consumer_tone_finding: In homeowner complaint data (SCDCA 2026 HOA Report, r/HOA), residents fighting unfair fines or ignored records requests find imperative slogans (the retired working name) dismissive when management is non-compliant. 'ClearCovenant' communicates immediate practical utility (clear rules, clear budgets, clear records) for homeowners, volunteer boards, and communities alike. The working name was retired as a user-facing subtitle in v1.2.0-rc2.
